    Given a role without the Debt sale right of the surface calls the step
    When the call is made
    Then the caller gets 403 before any read and no record is written

  Scenario: AC17 Stale account or balance product holds the step (X4)
    Given the account or balance product is stale after a late or failed ACE batch
    When the step reads the account and balance facts
    Then the step holds, writes nothing and the user sees MSG-P1-001 with the data date

  Scenario: AC18 A dependency does not answer inside 2 s or its breaker is open (X5)
    Given rwb-source-data, rwb-case or rwb-decision does not answer inside 2 s or its breaker is open
    When the step calls it
    Then the step retries on the workflow's own schedule and the caller sees 503 with the platform error envelope

  Scenario: AC19 ALS or the general ledger rejects the posting (X6)
    Given ALS or the general ledger rejects the posting
    When the rejection code is returned
    Then the posting is held at POSTING_REJECTED_DS, the rejection code is written to the record, the exception task is raised and no further item is sent

    Given the same lot, business date and package version, or the same Idempotency-Key, is sent again
    When the repeat arrives
    Then one record, one item set and one answer per case exist and the repeat is counted
